test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six friends are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Aman is sitting second right to Sneha. Tushar is immediate left to Sneha. Ritika is not the immediate neighbour of either Sneha or Tushar. Ritika is sitting second right to Prerna. Sharique is sitting in between Ritika and Tushar. Who is is the immediate neighbour of both Tushar and Prerna?
solution:
Representing the given arrangement:

1) Six friends are sitting around a circular table facing the centre

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/887567b85ab5ac42e9b8da5d9d8efc2e1b7ffb1be7e35668c813115fa608ce26.png] 

2) Aman is sitting second right to Sneha

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdca54bd01019e2ec06cc6cbed25ad79a3b4c4501fa39b6afd875cc95528df94.png] 

3) Tushar is immediate left to Sneha

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/453aff47bfa3d875ffe6e264e712c1124072ab6a938f37fe68e594673971ab65.png] 

4) Ritika is not the immediate neighbour of either Sneha or Tushar

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ac314b70d28364115158f7e123e9c3e89e283aa4c764e807686de61b6fb692a.png] 

5) Ritika is sitting second right to Prerna

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac779dbc35458dc480f66d767870c8cee1f3396025aebe832a27119a90889c2d.png] 

6) Sharique is sitting in between Ritika and Tushar

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08bea6761d8d1e69d2b2b718f57e6a9106fd061b0d4c63b44815df918a145da0.png] 

So, as we can see in the above figure, **Sneha** is the immediate neighbour of both Tushar and Prerna.

Hence, **option 4)** is the correct answer.
